text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An Emperor's absolute perfection is<n>not an easy
ideal to live up to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At times, I'm blinded by the sheer<n>brilliance of my
ideals...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But even if it is nigh impossible, I do<n>not wish to
settle for anything less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I beg you, Trainer. I will endure any<n>labor you
propose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Train me until I can bear this burden!
choice_data_list: Let's take it one step at a time.
Time for the workout of a lifetime!
Time for the workout of a lifetime!

text_block_list.text: Train me until I can bear this burden!
choice_data_list: Let's take it one step at a time.
Time for the workout of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. I'll never attain perfection by<n>letting my
emotions get the better of<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. I've regained my<n>composure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yet again, you've taught me a<n>valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ha, I would expect nothing less.<n>There's no need
to hold back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I wish to preach, I must be willing to<n>practice!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My victory must be absolute! My<n>prowess
beyond question!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am Symboli Rudolf, the Emperor—and<n>when I next
take to the track, I will<n>live up to that name!
